meta.title: Agent Wallet Demo · Yunshu AI
meta.description: An AI agent wallet with spending limits enforced on-chain: it pays for services on its own, is stopped when it goes over budget or out of scope, and every payment is on a public record.

banner: Test network only. No real money.
heading: An agent that pays on its own, and can't overspend
intro: An AI agent gets its own wallet with spending limits written into a smart contract. It pays for API calls by itself. Any payment that breaks a rule is refused before money moves, and every payment and refusal is on a public record anyone can check.
status: In development. The contracts aren't deployed yet; live payments will appear on this page once they are.

steps.title: The agent calls a paid API
steps.body: The API answers 402 Payment Required with a price, for example 0.01 test USDC, using the open x402 standard.

steps.title: The wallet checks the rules
steps.body: Before signing, the agent asks its wallet contract to authorise the payment. The contract checks every limit on-chain, where the agent can't get around it.

steps.title: Allowed: the payment settles
steps.body: The agent signs a standard x402 payment with the wallet as payer. The x402 facilitator settles it in test USDC and the API returns its data.

steps.title: Refused: nothing moves
steps.body: The contract records the refusal as a public event with its reason. No money moves and the API is never paid.

rules.heading: The rules each agent wallet enforces
rules.intro: The operator sets these. A change applies from the agent's very next payment.

items.name: Per-payment cap
items.body: No single payment may be larger than this.

items.name: Daily budget
items.body: Total spend per day (UTC) can't go over this.

items.name: Task budget
items.body: Each task the agent works on has its own budget.

items.name: Allowed payees
items.body: The agent can only pay addresses on its list.

items.name: Pause switch
items.body: The operator can stop all payments at once.

reasons.heading: Why a payment can be refused
reasons.intro: Every refusal carries exactly one of these reasons, checked in this order.

items.body: The operator has paused this agent.
The amount is zero, or the payment has already expired.
The recipient isn't on the agent's allowed list.
This single payment is above the per-payment cap.
It would push the task over its budget.
It would push today's spending over the daily budget.
The wallet doesn't hold enough USDC.
